description: This file contains functions for exporting and importing various chat flow and message data, including handling of IDs, data transformation, and database interactions within a chat application backend.

methods.name: convertExportInput
methods.description: Converts and validates request body into ExportInput type, throwing error if invalid.

methods.name: exportData
methods.description: Fetches and compiles export data based on input flags and workspace ID, including chat flows, messages, templates, documents, and other entities.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForChatFlow
methods.description: Replaces duplicate chat flow IDs in the data with new UUIDs to prevent conflicts during import.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForAssistant
methods.description: Replaces duplicate assistant IDs in the data with new UUIDs.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForChatMessage
methods.description: Replaces duplicate chat message IDs and updates message references accordingly.

methods.name: replaceExecutionIdForChatMessage
methods.description: Replaces execution IDs in chat messages with null if not found in database or import data.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForChatMessageFeedback
methods.description: Replaces duplicate IDs in chat message feedback entries.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForCustomTemplate
methods.description: Replaces duplicate custom template IDs.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForDocumentStore
methods.description: Replaces duplicate document store IDs.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForDocumentStoreFileChunk
methods.description: Replaces duplicate document store file chunk IDs.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForTool
methods.description: Replaces duplicate tool IDs.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForVariable
methods.description: Replaces duplicate variable IDs, filtering out 'runtime' type variables in cloud platform.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForExecution
methods.description: Replaces duplicate execution IDs.

methods.name: reduceSpaceForChatflowFlowData
methods.description: Converts flowData of chat flows to stringified JSON.

methods.name: insertWorkspaceId
methods.description: Assigns workspaceId to imported data items, modifies Tool items for backward compatibility.

methods.name: saveBatch
methods.description: Saves entities in batches to database.

methods.name: importData
methods.description: Imports data into database, handling ID replacements, usage limits, and transaction management.

methods.name: exportChatflowMessages
methods.description: Exports chat messages and associated artifacts, grouping by session, with support for filtering by type and feedback.

methods.name: getChatPK
methods.description: Generates a primary key string for chat sessions based on chatId, memoryType, and sessionId.

methods.name: getChatType
methods.description: Returns display name for a given ChatType enum.
